title: Smoky Ethiopian Mitsuba Stir Fry
description: A spicy and savory Japanese-inspired stir fry featuring the unique flavor of Ethiopian Mitsuba and a smoky kick.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Mitsuba, ginger, and red pepper, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the sweet potatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sugar.
Pour the sauce over the vegetables and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped green onions.
